csv_project_name: Engrg Svc for NYS Route 12 & NYS Route 12D Main St
csv_scope_of_work: The Village of Boonville seeks proposals from qualified firms to provide full-service planning. design, engineering, SEQRA environmental review, permitting, bidding, and construction administration/reporting services. This project, part of the Village's DRI/NY Forward initiative, will enhance downtown gateways and the Main Street corridor at the northern and southern entrances to downtown Boonville along NYS Route 12 and NYS Route 12D-Main Street. This project aims to attract travelers from NYS Route 12 into Boonville's historic district by creating welcoming northern and southern gateways that showcase the Village's historic, quaint downtown and invite visitors to "Discover Boonville." Design, Engineering and Construction services related to the implementation improvements to Main Street and the Gateways at NYS Route 12 and 12D
